lead.titleZh: 结构化运动与癌症生存：系统综述提供证据
lead.titleEn: Structured Exercise and Cancer Survival: Systematic Review Provides Evidence
lead.paragraphZh: 今日日报关注的是一项评分 90 的系统综述，该研究整合了随机对照试验的证据，探讨了结构化运动干预对癌症患者生存结局的影响。另有两条评分 85 的系统综述，分别关注慢性下腰痛患者的最佳运动剂量以及血流限制运动在骨骼肌肉康复中的应用。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's digest highlights a top-scoring systematic review (score 90) that synthesized evidence from randomized controlled trials on the impact of structured exercise interventions on survival outcomes in cancer patients. Additionally, two systematic reviews with scores of 85 examine optimal exercise dosing for chronic low back pain and the efficacy of blood flow restriction exercise in musculoskeletal rehabilitation.

items.title: Optimal exercise dose in adults with chronic low back pain disorders: systematic review with dose-response network meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 239 trials found that low to moderate exercise doses were associated with short-term, potentially clinically meaningful improvements in disability and pain intensity for chronic low back pain, with optimal model-predicted doses of 4 sessions/week, 25 min/session over 13 weeks for disability, and 3 sessions/week, 30 min/session over 8 weeks for pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 239 项试验的系统综述指出了慢性下腰痛的运动剂量建议，但强调证据确定性极低。对短期残疾和疼痛，它给出了模型预测的最佳剂量，但别过分解读，继续将运动疗法作为一线，但保持个性化。
items.titleZh: 慢性下腰痛患者的最佳运动剂量：系统综述与剂量反应网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 239 项试验的系统综述与网络荟萃分析发现，中低强度运动剂量与慢性下腰痛患者短期残疾和疼痛强度的临床有意义改善相关；模型预测的最佳剂量为短期残疾 4 次/周、25 分钟/次，持续 13 周，短期疼痛 3 次/周、30 分钟/次，持续 8 周。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review of 239 trials provides exercise dose recommendations for chronic low back pain, but emphasizes very low certainty of evidence. While it offers model-predicted optimal doses for short-term disability and pain, avoid over-interpreting these. Continue to prioritize exercise therapy as a first-line intervention, but maintain a personalized approach.
items.limitation: 绝大多数纳入研究存在高偏倚风险，且证据确定性极低，模型预测的剂量建议需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The vast majority of included studies had a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was very low to low, necessitating cautious interpretation of model-predicted dose recommendations.

items.title: Combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training improves proprioception and dynamic balance in female karatekas with flatfoot: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training (SF-3DAE) led to greater improvements in navicular drop (2.24 mm vs 1.16 mm), ankle proprioception (3° vs 1.59° error), and dynamic balance (17.49% vs 7.82% Y-Balance total reach) compared to short-foot exercise (SFE) alone in female karate athletes with flatfoot.
items.curatedReason: 对于扁平足空手道运动员，这项 RCT 表明三维踝关节训练与短足训练结合，在改善足部姿态、本体感觉和动态平衡方面优于单独的短足训练。这提示你可以考虑将多平面踝关节训练纳入此类运动员的足部康复方案。
items.titleZh: 三维踝关节训练结合短足训练可改善扁平足女性空手道运动员的本体感觉和动态平衡：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，扁平足女性空手道运动员采用三维踝关节训练结合短足训练（SF-3DAE）在足舟骨下沉、踝关节本体感觉和动态平衡方面，优于单独短足训练（SFE）；SF-3DAE 组足舟骨下沉减少 2.24 毫米，本体感觉误差减少 3°，Y-Balance 总触及增加 17.49 个百分点，均显著优于 SFE 组。
items.curatedReasonEn: For flatfoot karate athletes, this RCT suggests that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training is superior to short-foot training alone for improving foot posture, proprioception, and dynamic balance. This indicates you might consider incorporating multi-planar ankle training into foot rehabilitation programs for such athletes.
items.limitation: 由于联合训练组的训练量更大，无法完全排除训练量增加带来的影响；且研究未评估这些改善是否能转化为运动表现提升或受伤风险降低。
items.limitationEn: The increased training volume in the combined exercise group means the contribution of training volume effect cannot be fully separated, and the study did not assess whether these improvements translate into enhanced athletic performance or reduced injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Turf toe: an occupational hazard in football players
items.summary: This case report describes a 23-year-old collegiate male football player presenting with acute right great toe pain and hyperextension injury after playing on natural turf, diagnosed with a high-grade plantar plate ('turf toe') injury involving complete rupture of the medial and lateral sesamophalangeal ligaments.
items.curatedReason: “人工草坪趾”（Turf toe）是足球运动员常见的足部损伤。作为物理治疗师，在评估足部疼痛时应警惕这种高等级跖趾关节损伤，尤其是当患者在人工草坪上运动后出现持续疼痛和功能受限时。
items.titleZh: 人工草坪趾：足球运动员的职业危害
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 23 岁大学橄榄球男运动员在天然草坪上比赛后出现急性右脚大脚趾疼痛和过伸损伤，诊断为高等级跖趾关节（“人工草坪趾”）损伤，涉及内侧和外侧籽骨趾骨韧带完全断裂。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turf toe is a common foot injury in football players. As physical therapists, be vigilant for this high-grade MTPJ injury when evaluating foot pain, especially if patients experience persistent pain and functional limitations after playing on artificial turf.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例报告，其结果不具备普适性，仅提供个案参考价值。
items.limitationEn: This is a case report, so its findings are not generalizable and only offer insights from a single case.

items.title: Opioid use following spinal cord injury: a qualitative study of the perspectives of healthcare providers and people with lived experience.
items.summary: A qualitative study based on interviews with 14 healthcare providers and 9 people with spinal cord injury (SCI) in Australia found that opioid use is normalized in acute care post-SCI, creating an overreliance that extends into rehabilitation and community settings due to limited follow-up and access to non-pharmacological pain supports.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了脊髓损伤患者术后阿片类药物使用在住院和社区护理中的常态化问题，以及澳大利亚医疗系统在综合疼痛管理方面的挑战。它提示你应该在患者教育和跨学科协作方面发挥作用，以减少阿片类药物依赖，并倡导更好的非药物疼痛管理支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后阿片类药物使用：医疗服务提供者和有亲身经验者的视角定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 名医疗服务提供者和 9 名脊髓损伤（SCI）患者进行的定性研究发现，SCI 后急性期阿片类药物使用常态化，导致在康复和社区环境中过度依赖，这主要归因于随访不足和非药物疼痛支持的可及性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the normalization of opioid use in both inpatient and community settings after spinal cord injury, and challenges within the Australian healthcare system for comprehensive pain management. It suggests you have a role in patient education and interdisciplinary collaboration to reduce opioid reliance and advocate for better non-pharmacological pain management support.

items.title: From evidence to action: a global call to advance sleep health in sport
items.summary: This editorial highlights the growing awareness of sleep health in sport but notes that many high-performance environments still operate contrary to healthy sleep and circadian biology, calling for a global, coordinated effort to implement evidence-based sleep health practices.
items.curatedReason: 运动领域对睡眠健康的认知度显著提高，但高绩效环境中的实践仍与健康睡眠和昼夜节律不符。应利用证据制定更实际的睡眠健康策略，这对于运动员的康复和表现至关重要。
items.titleZh: 从证据到行动：促进运动睡眠健康的全球倡议
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论指出，体育界对睡眠健康的认识显著提高，但许多高绩效环境的运作方式仍与健康睡眠和昼夜节律生物学相悖，呼吁全球协同努力，实施循证睡眠健康实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: While awareness of sleep health in sports has significantly increased, high-performance environments still operate in ways misaligned with healthy sleep and circadian biology. Evidence should be leveraged to develop more practical sleep health strategies, which are crucial for athlete recovery and performance.

items.title: Training-related concussions in mens English Premiership Rugby Union: an eight-season prospective cohort study of 153 243 player-weeks
items.summary: An eight-season prospective cohort study (153,243 player-weeks) in elite men's English Premiership Rugby Union found a training-related concussion incidence of 0.23 per 1000 hours, with preseason (IRR 1.80) and full-contact training (IRR 2.20) significantly increasing risk compared to the final three months of the season and non-contact training.
items.curatedReason: 英式橄榄球中，季前赛和全面接触训练与训练相关脑震荡风险增加密切相关。在设计训练计划时，应战略性规划这些高风险时段，以最大程度地降低运动员受伤风险。
items.titleZh: 英式橄榄球超级联赛男子训练相关脑震荡：一项为期八个赛季的 153,243 运动员周前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对英式橄榄球超级联赛男子精英运动员进行的为期八个赛季（153,243 运动员周）的前瞻性队列研究发现，训练相关脑震荡发生率为每 1000 小时 0.23 例。与赛季末三个月和非接触训练相比，季前赛（IRR 1.80）和全面接触训练（IRR 2.20）显著增加了脑震荡风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: In English Premiership Rugby Union, preseason and full-contact training are closely associated with an increased risk of training-related concussions. These high-risk periods should be strategically planned when designing training programs to minimize athlete injury risk.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅限于精英男子橄榄球运动员，结果可能不完全适用于其他运动或人群。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to elite male rugby players, and results may not be fully generalizable to other sports or populations.

items.title: Multidimensional evidence map of sport science and medicine research in highly trained, elite and world-class female athletes: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of 3,867 records (1970-2025) on sport science and medicine research in highly trained female athletes found increasing but persistent gaps in participant representation (31% female), geographical coverage, and health-related themes, with pelvic floor (26 studies), breast health (11 studies), and (peri-)menopause (2 studies) being least common.
items.curatedReason: 尽管高水平女性运动员的研究在增加，但在参与者代表性、地理覆盖和健康相关主题（如盆底、乳房健康、围绝经期）方面仍存在显著空白。作为临床医生，应更关注这些被忽视的领域，推动以女性为中心的康复研究和实践。
items.titleZh: 高水平、精英和世界级女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的多维证据图谱：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 3,867 份（1970-2025 年）关于高水平女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的范围综述发现，尽管研究在增加，但在参与者代表性（31% 女性）、地理覆盖和健康相关主题方面仍存在持续的空白，其中盆底（26 项研究）、乳房健康（11 项研究）和（围）绝经期（2 项研究）是最不常见的。
items.curatedReasonEn: Although research on high-level female athletes is increasing, significant gaps remain in participant representation, geographical coverage, and health-related themes (e.g., pelvic floor, breast health, perimenopause). As clinicians, we should focus more on these underserved areas to advance female-centered rehabilitation research and practice.
items.limitation: 此为范围综述，不提供干预效果的量化证据，主要揭示研究现状和空白。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that provides an overview of the research landscape and gaps, not quantitative evidence of intervention effects.

items.title: Availability in elite football: a practical framework for recording and communicating player health status
items.summary: This paper proposes a practical framework for recording and communicating elite football players' health status and availability to address the gap in traditional surveillance systems, which are primarily designed for research and do not consistently inform daily training and match planning.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章提出了一个精英足球运动员健康状况记录和沟通的实用框架，旨在解决现有监测系统无法有效传达球员日常可用性的问题。这对于在运动领域工作的物理治疗师非常有价值，可以帮助您更高效地与教练和性能团队沟通，优化训练计划和比赛决策。
items.titleZh: 精英足球运动员的可用性：记录和沟通球员健康状况的实用框架
items.summaryZh: 本文提出了一个记录和沟通精英足球运动员健康状况和可用性的实用框架，旨在弥补传统监测系统（主要为研究设计）在日常训练和比赛计划中信息传达不一致的不足。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you work in elite football, this framework is tailored for you. It addresses the shortcomings of traditional surveillance systems in communicating player daily availability, helping you more effectively communicate player health status with coaching and performance staff, thereby optimizing training plans and match lineup decisions, making your work more efficient.

items.title: Associations of physical, psychosocial and dual-career loads with injury and illness occurrence among elite handball players (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report outlines a thesis investigating how physical, psychosocial, and dual-career loads contribute to injuries and illnesses in elite handball players, adopting a biopsychosocial perspective to move beyond traditional physical injury etiology models.
items.curatedReason: 精英手球运动员的伤病发生不仅与生理负荷有关，还与心理社会和双重职业负荷密切相关。在制定康复和预防策略时，应整合生物心理社会视角，全面评估运动员的多种负荷。
items.titleZh: 精英手球运动员的生理、心理社会和双重职业负荷与伤病发生关联（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告概述了一项博士论文，旨在调查生理、心理社会和双重职业负荷如何影响精英手球运动员的伤病发生，并采用生物心理社会视角，超越传统的生理伤病病因模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: Injuries in elite handball players are not only linked to physical load but also closely associated with psychosocial and dual-career loads. When developing rehabilitation and prevention strategies, a biopsychosocial perspective should be integrated to comprehensively assess athletes' multiple loads.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: Muscle injuries in football: integrating structural and neuromuscular outcomes to minimise reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report outlines a thesis integrating seven studies across three phases—exploratory analyses, muscle structure, and neuromuscular function/performance outcomes—to minimize reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance after muscle injuries in football players, also validating a portable ultrasound device.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员肌肉损伤后的康复策略应整合结构和神经肌肉功能评估，以降低再损伤风险并提升赛后表现。临床医生在制定重返赛场（RTP）标准时，要关注大腿肌肉形态和力-速度曲线的变化。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员肌肉损伤：整合结构和神经肌肉功能结果以最小化再损伤风险并提高伤后表现（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告概述了一项博士论文，通过探索性分析、肌肉结构和神经肌肉功能/表现结果三个阶段的七项研究，旨在最小化足球运动员肌肉损伤后的再损伤风险并提高伤后表现，同时验证了一种便携式超声设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation strategies for muscle injuries in football players should integrate structural and neuromuscular function assessments to minimize reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance. Clinicians setting Return to Play (RTP) criteria should focus on changes in thigh muscle morphology and force-velocity profiles.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: The load-velocity profile as a muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults: a multifactorial perspective (PhD Academy Award).
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award report explores the load-velocity profile as a potential muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults, offering a multifactorial perspective on its clinical utility.
items.curatedReason: 负荷-速度曲线有望成为评估老年人肌肉质量和预测跌倒风险的指标，为制定个性化康复方案提供更多信息。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子：多因素视角（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖报告探讨了负荷-速度曲线作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子的潜力，并从多因素视角分析其临床应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The load-velocity profile could serve as an index for assessing muscle quality and predicting fall risk in older adults, offering additional information for personalized rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士奖项报告，完整方法学细节和结果需参考后续发表的论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD Academy Award report; full methodological details and results will be available in the subsequent published paper.

items.title: Structured exercise interventions and survival outcomes in patients with cancer: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs (n=3828 for overall survival) found that structured exercise interventions were associated with significant improvements in overall survival (HR 0.77; 95% CI 0.65 to 0.92), disease-free survival (HR 0.83; 95% CI 0.72 to 0.95), reduced all-cause mortality (RR 0.82), and reduced cancer-specific mortality (RR 0.74) in patients with cancer, with moderate certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 结构化运动干预不仅能改善癌症患者的生活质量和身体功能，还能显著延长总生存期（HR 0.77）和无病生存期（HR 0.83）。这为肿瘤康复中的运动处方提供了坚实的证据，应将其视为癌症治疗的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 结构化运动干预与癌症患者生存结局：随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 21 项随机对照试验（总生存期 n=3828）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，结构化运动干预与癌症患者的总生存期（HR 0.77；95% CI 0.65 至 0.92）、无病生存期（HR 0.83；95% CI 0.72 至 0.95）、全因死亡率降低（RR 0.82）和癌症特异性死亡率降低（RR 0.74）显著相关，证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: Structured exercise interventions not only improve quality of life and physical function in cancer patients but also significantly prolong overall survival (HR 0.77) and disease-free survival (HR 0.83). This provides strong evidence for exercise prescription in oncology rehabilitation and should be considered an adjuvant therapy in cancer care.
items.limitation: 纳入 RCT 的证据确定性为中等，且存在样本量和异质性问题。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence for the included RCTs is moderate, and there are issues with sample size and heterogeneity.

items.title: Combinations of stepping intensity and daily step counts against all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality: insights from a device-based prospective study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (64,743 UK Biobank participants) found that combinations of stepping intensity (peak 30-min cadence) and daily step counts (<5000, 5000-7500, 7500-10,000, >10,000 steps/day) were associated with different risks for all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality, with 7500-10,000 steps/day at approximately 100 steps/min showing the lowest all-cause mortality risk (HR 0.57; 95% CI 0.47 to 0.69).
items.curatedReason: 步数强度和每日步数对全因及心血管疾病死亡率的影响存在多种组合。建议患者不要只关注步数总量，同时考虑步速和中高强度步行的重要性。
items.titleZh: 步数强度与每日步数组合对全因和心血管疾病死亡率的影响：一项基于设备的前瞻性研究的见解
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（64,743 名英国生物样本库参与者）发现，步数强度（峰值 30 分钟步频）和每日步数（<5000、5000-7500、7500-10,000、>10,000 步/天）的组合与全因及心血管疾病死亡率的不同风险相关，其中 7500-10,000 步/天且步频约 100 步/分钟的全因死亡率风险最低（HR 0.57；95% CI 0.47 至 0.69）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Various combinations of stepping intensity and daily step counts influence all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality. Advise patients not to focus solely on total steps, but also to consider the importance of stepping cadence and moderate-to-vigorous intensity walking.
items.limitation: 研究使用腕戴式加速计数据，可能存在测量误差，且人群以英国生物样本库参与者为主，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study used wrist-worn accelerometer data, which may have measurement errors, and the population primarily consists of UK Biobank participants, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Do blood flow restriction exercises offer additional benefits when compared to conventional exercises in musculoskeletal rehabilitation? A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 45 RCTs (1652 participants) found low-certainty evidence that low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) was superior to low-load exercise (LLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.82) and disability (SMD=0.63). Moderate-certainty evidence showed no clear difference between LLE-BFR and high-load exercise (HLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.08).
items.curatedReason: 对肌肉骨骼康复而言，低负荷血流限制训练（LLE-BFR）在改善肌力和功能障碍方面优于低负荷训练（LLE），且与高负荷训练（HLE）效果相当。将 LLE-BFR 纳入临床实践，可为无法承受高负荷的患者提供有效选择。
items.titleZh: 与肌肉骨骼康复中的常规运动相比，血流限制运动是否提供额外益处？一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 45 项随机对照试验（1652 名受试者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，低确定性证据表明低负荷血流限制运动（LLE-BFR）在肌力（SMD=0.82）和功能障碍（SMD=0.63）方面优于低负荷运动（LLE）。中等确定性证据显示，LLE-BFR 与高负荷运动（HLE）在肌力方面无明显差异（SMD=0.08）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For musculoskeletal rehabilitation, low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) is superior to low-load exercise (LLE) in improving muscle strength and disability, and comparable to high-load exercise (HLE). Incorporating LLE-BFR into clinical practice offers an effective option for patients unable to tolerate high loads.
items.limitation: 大部分纳入研究的偏倚风险为“存在一些担忧”，且证据确定性从低到极低，这限制了结论的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: Most included trials had 'some concerns' for risk of bias, and evidence certainty ranged from low to very low, limiting the robustness of conclusions.

items.title: APTA Presses for Inclusion of CPT Codes in UHC Prior Authorization Reforms
items.summary: APTA is advocating for the inclusion of commonly used CPT codes in UnitedHealthcare's prior authorization reforms after UHC's recent announcement eliminated 30% of requirements but excluded physical therapy services, highlighting ongoing efforts for prior authorization reduction.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 正推动将常用的 CPT 代码纳入联合健康保险 (UHC) 的预授权改革中，以减少物理治疗服务的行政障碍。这直接影响你在美国市场的报销和执业效率，需密切关注 APTA 的后续行动。
items.titleZh: APTA 敦促将 CPT 代码纳入 UHC 预授权改革
items.summaryZh: 在美国联合健康保险 (UHC) 最近宣布削减 30% 预授权要求但未包含物理治疗服务后，APTA 正积极倡导将常用的 CPT 代码纳入 UHC 的预授权改革，以推动预授权要求的进一步简化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) is pushing for the inclusion of commonly used CPT codes in UnitedHealthcare's (UHC) prior authorization reforms to reduce administrative barriers for physical therapy services. This directly impacts your reimbursement and practice efficiency in the U.S. market, and you should closely monitor APTA's follow-up actions.

items.title: CMS Refocuses Medicaid Quality on Health Outcomes, Launches Innovative Partnership With 37 States
items.summary: CMS is refocusing Medicaid quality on health outcomes and launching an innovative partnership with 37 states to improve care delivery. This initiative aims to enhance the accountability of Medicaid programs by prioritizing measurable improvements in patient health.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 宣布将 Medicaid 质量衡量重新聚焦于健康结果，并与 37 个州启动创新伙伴关系。这代表了美国医疗补助政策的重大转向，预示着未来报销模式和质量指标可能发生变化，直接影响物理治疗师在 Medicaid 服务中的执业与报销策略。
items.titleZh: 阅读更多关于 CMS 将 Medicaid 质量重新聚焦于健康结果，并与 37 个州启动创新伙伴关系
items.summaryZh: CMS 正将 Medicaid 的质量重点重新放在健康结果上，并与 37 个州启动一项创新伙伴关系，以改善医疗服务。该倡议旨在通过优先考虑患者健康的可衡量改进来增强 Medicaid 项目的问责制。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) announced a refocusing of Medicaid quality measures on health outcomes and an innovative partnership with 37 states. This represents a significant shift in US Medicaid policy, signaling potential changes in reimbursement models and quality metrics, directly impacting physical therapists' practice and billing strategies within Medicaid services.

items.title: Removing barriers to physical activity for people with long-term conditions: co-creating patient-centred guidance through a multistakeholder consensus approach
items.summary: This study developed patient-centered, consensus-based digital guidance that offers an alternative to routine medical clearance for people with long-term conditions engaging in organized physical activity. It aims to remove existing barriers by supporting informed, autonomous decision-making through four headline safety statements and seven symptom-specific statements.
items.curatedReason: 为慢性病患者提供运动指导时，不应再常规要求医疗许可。这项研究共创的患者中心化指南能帮助患者自主决策，降低参与运动的门槛，值得在临床实践中推广。
items.titleZh: 消除慢性病患者参与身体活动的障碍：通过多方利益相关者共识方法共同制定以患者为中心的指南
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过多方利益相关者共识方法，制定了以患者为中心的数字化指南，旨在替代慢性病患者参与有组织身体活动的常规医疗许可。该指南包含四项主要安全声明和七项针对症状的声明，旨在通过支持知情、自主决策来消除现有障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Medical clearance should no longer be routinely required for patients with long-term conditions when providing exercise guidance. This co-created patient-centered guidance empowers patients to make autonomous decisions, reducing barriers to physical activity, and is worth promoting in clinical practice.

items.title: 2027 ICD-10 Coding Changes Go Into Effect October 1. Here's What Could Impact Rehab Therapists
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is implementing its annual updates to ICD-10 coding, which will go into effect on October 1, 2026. These changes impact how rehab therapists will code for diagnoses and procedures, affecting reimbursement and compliance.
items.curatedReason: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）的 ICD-10 编码每年都在更新，影响着你在诊断和报销时的准确性。立即了解这些即将生效的年度变化，确保你的账单合规，避免申诉和收入损失。
items.titleZh: 2027年ICD-10编码变更将于10月1日生效，康复治疗师可能受到的影响
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）即将实施年度ICD-10编码更新，将于2026年10月1日生效。这些变化将影响康复治疗师诊断和操作的编码方式，从而影响报销和合规性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The annual updates to ICD-10 coding by CMS affect the accuracy of your diagnoses and reimbursements. Immediately familiarize yourself with these upcoming annual changes to ensure billing compliance and avoid claims denials and revenue loss.

items.title: Five years on, NO PROGRESS: the gender equity crisis in sport and exercise medicine publishing persists - action is now overdue
items.summary: A review of the top 50 SCImago-ranked journals for sport medicine and physical therapy reveals that gender inequity in publishing has not improved over the past five years, with women representing only 33% of first authors in 2024, mirroring previous findings from 2008/2009 and 2018/2019.
items.curatedReason: 运动与运动医学出版领域的性别不平等问题持续存在且未改善，女性作者比例仍仅为 33%。PT 领域同样面临此挑战，应关注并促进公平。
items.titleZh: 五年过去，毫无进展：运动与运动医学出版领域的性别平等危机持续存在——行动刻不容缓
items.summaryZh: 对排名前 50 的运动医学和物理治疗期刊的审查显示，出版领域的性别不平等在过去五年中并未改善，2024 年女性第一作者的比例仍为 33%，与 2008/2009 年和 2018/2019 年的研究结果相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gender inequity persists and shows no improvement in sport and exercise medicine publishing, with women authors still at only 33%. The PT field faces similar challenges and should actively promote equity.
